operands.name: box
operands.layout: if mode==2: f32 xmin, f32 ymin, f32 xmax, f32 ymax; any other mode: f32 xmin, f32 ymin, f32 zmin, f32 xmax, f32 ymax, f32 zmax

operands.name: action
operands.layout: branch action: u8 A, then A==0xFE: off32 then_target, off32 else_target; A==0xFC or A==0x0C: off32 target (offset 0 = null); A==0xFD: nothing; any other A: nothing. Executed after all operands of the opcode have been read: if the condition is true, A==0x0C goto target, A==0xFC or 0xFE gosub (then_)target, A==0xFD return; if false and A==0xFE gosub else_target; otherwise continue

summary: Condition: mask==0xFF: some active object of that type in the arena is inside the box; otherwise one of the 3 player projectile slots (0x573c98, 0xfc bytes each) with type t (slot+0xd0, 1..4) and mask bit 1<<(t-1) is inside the box (slot position +0x20). Tests xmin<=x<=xmax and ymin<=y<=ymax, plus zmin<=z<=zmax only when mode==3 (order confirmed by LEVEL4/LEVEL7 data; the 8 boxes in LEVEL7 DANT_6 have an empty z range and never pass).

obj+7 = mode: 1 = this object is the global alien target (0x491e48); 2 = this object always targets Kurt (target position 0x57fc34 = Kurt's position/yaw now). mode 0 releases 0x491e48 if it was this object.

Gosub to one of N targets chosen at random: pushes (pc after the operands, obj+0x108) on the 4-deep stack obj+0x24c/obj+0x25c, depth obj+0x248++, then obj+0x108 = pc = target, obj+0x26c[depth] = 0. Overflow (depth>=4): debug log, obj+0x108 = 0, return.
Return from gosub: depth--, pc = obj+0x24c[depth], obj+0x108 = obj+0x25c[depth]. Underflow (depth 0): debug log, obj+0x108 = 0, return.
Handled by the interpreter loop (0x440ce3): clears the hit event obj+0x21e and returns; obj+0x108 is unchanged so the next frame restarts at the last restart point.
note: not in the jump table; interpreter loop
